tasks.title: Fog's sea-thinning samples the clamped edge, so the off-map margin reads as land
tasks.why: MapFog.Alpha (MapFog.cs:81) thins alpha by SeaShare only where ContinentMesh.HeightAt(...) < 0f, but x/z there range over the whole fog grid, which reaches FogMargin (14 m) past the land on every side (StrategicMapView.FogMargin, FogGrid). HeightAt clamps u/v to 0..1 (ContinentMesh.cs:62), so every texel in that 14 m, 28-texel-wide perimeter band samples the nearest in-bounds edge row instead of being off the map. The basin's own edge height (ContinentMesh.Heights, ContinentMesh.cs:31) is only -0.2 before noise, and the noise amplitude is +-0.6 (NoiseAmplitude, ContinentMesh.cs:17), so a coastal row that lands above zero is read all the way out across the margin: the fog there stays at full Density over open water the Sea mesh already shows as sea, instead of the SeaShare thinning StrategicMapMeshTests.The_Fog_Is_Thinner_Over_The_Sea_And_Along_The_Front only checks at one interior point (grid.Index(-10f,-10f)), not along a noisy edge.
tasks.done_when: An EditMode test asserts MapFog.Alpha is thinned by SeaShare for every texel in the FogMargin perimeter band regardless of the nearest edge row's raw height, and is red against today's HeightAt.

tasks.title: MetaKeyLight's Take(Color,float), the overload both views call, has no test
tasks.why: StrategicMapView.Show (StrategicMapView.cs:99) and HomeFrontDiorama.Show (HomeFrontDiorama.cs:91) both call keyLight.Take(color, intensity) (MetaKeyLight.cs:14-23), the overload that searches the scene for the one directional light with FindObjectsByType and silently does nothing if none is found. MetaPickTests.Take_Saves_Then_ReTints_On_A_Second_Take only exercises the other overload, Take(Light,...) (MetaKeyLight.cs:25-34), which neither production caller uses. The search loop and its null-light early return could be deleted or broken and no test would go red.
tasks.done_when: A new MetaPickTests case calls MetaKeyLight.Take(Color,float) (no Light argument) against a scene directional light and fails if the FindObjectsByType search is removed or returns the wrong light.
